description: Territoire à Risque Important d'Inondation (TRI) de Compiègne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Based on the national Preliminary Flood Risk Assessment (PFRA) and the PFRAs of each river basin district, 122 Significant Flood Risk Territories (SFRTs) have been established throughout the national territory. These territories are subject to an in-depth risk diagnosis. This table represents the TRI of Compiègne. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Territory with Significant Flood Risk (TRI) of Compiègne" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
